listing.name: Seihou Densetsu: Shuusou Gyoku (GIAN07)
listing.summary: Attach an independently permitted, prepared modern GIAN07 Windows x86 player for Shuusou Gyoku with your own original resources. Keep the modern SDL3 route separate from vintage binaries and replay tooling; the retained original README is not the current build contract.

steps.title: Prepare the original resources upstream
steps.instruction: Use a complete modern GIAN07 copy/components you are independently permitted to use, with your own Shuusou Gyoku original graphics, audio, scripts and other required retail resources. The source release omits those resources. Keep a complete original installation and independent recovery; no original payload, extractor, compiler, helper or game is obtained or executed here. The exact retail data revision/full corpus fingerprints are not established by this bounded source/package inspection and remain Unknown.

steps.title: Use the actual modern Windows program
steps.instruction: The inspected official P0341 GIAN07-2026-10-05.zip contains GIAN07.exe as PE x86/014c, with its modern SDL3.dll and separately packaged support files. Keep the complete release and original resources. This is not an AMD64 executable or the vintage GIAN07_win98.exe / original-DirectDraw route. Some alternate-named entries in this ZIP are zero-byte placeholders; they are not runnable players and are not selected by this guide. The current source’s modern Tup/SDL build instructions supersede the retained original historical README’s missing-link-source note for this route.

steps.title: Attach the prepared modern game
steps.instruction: After completing upstream resource/layout preparation, select the actual nonempty modern GIAN07.exe, use its complete prepared program/resource directory as working directory and leave arguments empty. Review the exact intent and request Play separately. The modern SDL main enters the game in that process; do not select the legacy Win98 variant, original executable, ssg_cli.exe replay tool or a zero-byte placeholder. Keep the complete installation instead of moving only the EXE.

steps.title: Preserve the executable-side player data
steps.instruction: The modern Windows data resolver uses the executable’s base folder. Keep the full prepared root, including the actual 秋霜CFG.DAT/other configuration, scores, replays, original data archives, bgm/ content and any established custom audio/resource paths. Preserve old installation roots before choosing another directory; source configuration formats and vintage/modern behavior do not prove cross-version score/replay compatibility. This guide performs no conversion, replay validation, backup, restore, migration or deletion.

steps.title: Keep source, replay and runtime acceptance separate
steps.instruction: Retain the project MIT and all SDL3, codec and other component notices; source licensing does not grant rights to original game resources or optional music. Latest-release replay checks are bounded upstream evidence, not all-playthrough equivalence, physical hardware or our native/installed/gameplay observation. Quit normally before upstream replacement/data work, preserve recovery and review/relink changed executable bytes. Linux/FreeBSD are separate build routes. No Supported or managed lifecycle acceptance is asserted; registration removal preserves external files.

warnings: Select the actual modern x86 GIAN07.exe and keep its executable-side resources/data. Vintage binaries, zero-byte placeholders and bounded replay checks have separate scope.
